pack.reason.not-a-pack: What you picked is not a pack. Pick a pack (a pack folder, an archive made by Export, or your team's pack repo address), not a service code repo. If you have no pack, create one with [Packs → Create New].
pack.reason.athena-folder: The folder you picked is an Athena folder, not a pack. If it is the Athena you used on this computer, import it with [Existing Athena] in [Packs → Import].
pack.reason.pack-json-unreadable: The pack settings file is broken and could not be read. Ask the person who gave you the pack to export it again, or pick another pack.
pack.reason.pack-json-not-object: The pack settings file is not in the right format. Ask the person who gave you the pack to export it again, or pick another pack.
pack.reason.repos-not-list: The repo list in the pack settings file is not in the right format. Ask the person who gave you the pack to export it again, or pick another pack.
pack.reason.bad-repo-name: The repo name "{name}" in the pack is not valid (only letters, digits and . _ -). Check with the person who gave you the pack.
pack.reason.format-newer: This pack was made by a newer version than this app. Update the app with [App update] in ⚙ Settings, then try again.
pack.reason.archive-unreadable: Could not read the archive {file}. Check that it is a .tar.gz made by Export and that the download was not cut off.
pack.reason.archive-extract-failed: Could not unpack the archive {file}. The file may be broken — download it again and import it.
pack.reason.archive-outside-path: The archive has a path that would unpack outside the pack ({path}), so it was not unpacked. Ask the person who gave you the pack to make it again with [Packs → Export].
pack.reason.too-many-files: The pack has too many files ({count}, max {max}). Check that you did not pick a service code repo.
pack.reason.too-large: The pack is too large (over {mb} MB). Check that you did not pick a service code repo.
pack.reason.clone-failed: Could not clone the git repo. Check that the address is right and that this computer has access to that repo.
pack.reason.git-url-format: The git address is not in a valid format. Use https://, ssh:// or git@host:path (no addresses containing passwords).
pack.reason.secret-file: Not imported because it has a file that may hold secrets ({file}). Get a pack without that file.
pack.reason.link-outside: Not imported because it has a link pointing outside the pack ({file}). Get a pack without that link.
pack.reason.link-missing: Not imported because it has a link pointing to nothing ({file}). Get a pack without that link.
pack.reason.not-regular-file: Not imported because it has an item that is not a regular file ({file}). Get a pack without that item.
pack.reason.git-link: Not imported because the pack's git folder (.git) is a link. If it is a pack repo, import it by address with [git Repo].
pack.reason.path-missing: Could not find {name}. Check that it was not moved or deleted, then pick it again.
pack.reason.not-athena-folder: The folder you picked is not an Athena folder. Pick the Athena folder you used before. Packs from others are imported via [Archive] · [Pack Folder] · [git Repo].
pack.reason.athena-no-pack: That Athena has no pack yet. Check that its first-run setup was finished, or create a new one with [Packs → Create New].
pack.reason.token-invalid: The import check does not match. Start [Packs → Import] again from the beginning.
pack.reason.token-expired: The import check is too old to continue. Start [Packs → Import] again from the beginning.
pack.reason.replace-missing: There is no matching pack on this computer to replace. Run [Packs → Import] again and register it as a new pack.
pack.reason.not-backup: The file you picked is not a work-history backup. If it only holds a pack, import it with [Archive] in [Packs → Import].
pack.reason.repo-not-packs-body: This Athena folder is not set up for packs, so repos cannot be added to a pack. Create a pack with [Packs → Create New], then add the repo there.
pack.reason.repo-not-git: The folder you picked is not a git repo. Pick a service code repo folder that you got with git (clone).
pack.reason.repo-inside-athena: Folders inside the Athena folder cannot be added as repos. Pick a service code repo outside the Athena folder.
pack.reason.repo-bad-name: The repo name {name} cannot be used. A repo name (the folder name) may only use letters, digits, and . _ - — rename the folder, then add it again.
pack.reason.repo-pack-not-set-up: This pack has not finished setup yet, so repos cannot be added. Finish the first-run setup in the Athena window, then add the repo again.
pack.reason.repo-exists: The pack already has a repo named {name} in a different folder. Keep using that repo, or right-click its row and use [Remove Repo from Pack…], then add this one again.
pack.reason.repo-missing: The pack has no repo named {name}. It may already have been removed — check the repo list.
pack.reason.repo-worktrees-left: The {name} repo still has work worktrees that were not cleaned up, so it was not removed. Finish that work and clean up the worktrees, then remove it again. The remaining worktrees are listed under [Details].
pack.reason.server-bad-host: The ssh alias is not valid. Pick a Host name from ~/.ssh/config (letters, digits, . _ -).
pack.reason.server-bad-name: The server name {name} cannot be used. Only lowercase letters, digits and - are allowed.
pack.reason.server-exists: The pack already has a server (or an agent) named {name}.
pack.reason.server-host-registered: That alias is already added as server {name}.
pack.reason.server-not-configured: {host} is not in ~/.ssh/config. Add that Host first.
pack.reason.server-missing: The pack has no server named {name}. It may already have been removed.
pack.reason.server-key-needed: Cannot log in to {host} without a password. Add this computer's public key to the server (ssh-copy-id {host}), then try again.
pack.reason.server-host-key: The host key of {host} is not trusted yet. Log in once with ssh {host} in a terminal to confirm the fingerprint, then try again.
pack.reason.server-unreachable: Cannot reach {host}. Check the network and that Host entry in ~/.ssh/config.

pack.delete.title: Delete the {name} pack?
pack.delete.body: This removes the pack's body, plans, issues, work history and worklist. Repo folders (code) stay as they are.
pack.delete.note: The pack and its work history are backed up first — you can bring it back later with [Import].
pack.delete.treesBody: Delete them too? Uncommitted changes are included in the backup.
pack.delete.open: A window is showing this pack — switch that window to another pack first
pack.delete.unsafe: This pack is tied to the main body and can't be deleted
pack.delete.doneNote: Backup file — bring it back with [Import]
pack.catchUp.working: This pack's body runs an older core and must move to the new one first — Athena or an agent is working, or the input has an unsent draft. Try again when it's done
pack.catchUp.unknownSession: This pack's body runs an older core and must move to the new one first — there's no record to resume the Athena conversation. Send Athena any message once, then try again
pack.catchUp.failed: Couldn't move this pack's body to the new core (details in pack.log)
pack.catchUp.notice: This pack's body runs an older core, so it moves to the new one first — this pack's Athena and agents stop, and Athena reopens the same conversation (any work in progress stops).

work.permission.body.browser: A Browser permission prompt is waiting. Open the original pane, review the destination and the scope of one-time or persistent permission, then choose there. This notice does not grant permission.
work.permission.body.trust: A startup trust prompt is waiting. Folder settings or hooks can run code, and trust choices may be saved. Read the files, warning and scope in the original pane and choose there.
work.permission.body.permission: A permission prompt is waiting. Review the request and permission scope in the original pane and choose there. This notice sends no approval or rejection.
work.permission.unavailable: Studio cannot verify the original request ID and response connection for this terminal prompt, so choices cannot be sent here. The notice clears automatically after you choose in the pane.
work.permission.closed: The original confirmation prompt has closed
work.approval.warning: Review the scope and content of the original request. Session approval may cover later requests; saved rules may apply in later sessions. Closing sends no response.
work.approval.stale: This request was already handled or its connection changed. Refresh the list.
